title: bEpic Viewer Professional ComfyUI Review Suite
summary: A high-performance visual inspection and comparison tool for ComfyUI designed for professional VFX-style review workflows. It features real-time exposure adjustment, RGB channel isolation, and advanced snapshot versioning.
research_notes: Personal use remains free while commercial usage requires a license from bEpic GmbH; the tool is a standard for professional quality control in ComfyUI.

evolution.summary: The tool has evolved from a basic previewer into a full-scale control center, adding undockable multi-monitor support, sequence timeline scrubbing, and the Parameters Panel for direct in-viewer node manipulation.
